diagnostics.score_band: median of100 heldout Q8 logL minus10; freeze formula before scoring
diagnostics.branches: cos(incl)<=0 and >0, source and postfit counts
diagnostics.moments: mean distance,mean sindec,branch fraction,circular sin/cos RA/psi/phase minus finite heldout empirical reference
diagnostics.predictive_density: normalized final q at100 heldout coordinates; paired map-minus-better-control mean and nominal SE, correlation caveat
diagnostics.normalization: existing AV mass/error<=1e-10, independent grouped-GMM mass error<=1e-5; q>=.2; exact law and density equality
diagnostics.weight_concentration: logL+normalized Planck15 source-frame cube logprior-logq; ESS/max weight only, no evidence estimate

utility.uncertainty_clause: operationalized conservatively before evaluation: mean paired logq advantage minus2 nominal SE>=1; not a calibrated CI for correlated teacher

early_stop.common_fitter_failure: all3 postfit clouds have0/100 high-score hits after first seed
early_stop.clear_map_failure: map source0/100 hits AND resampling source>=90/100 hits AND map mean heldout logq at least1nat below full-cache native
early_stop.action: stop all arms, no second seed; close current candidate/adapter line

terminal_rule: if minimum utility fails or remains uncertain after at most2 seeds, close current candidate/adapter line; any different direction requires explicit user judgment
forbidden: evidence estimates, posterior output/main cache, performance win, retraining, extra seeds, budget expansion, implementation sweep
trusted_checkpoint_read: own exact SHA256-verified stage11 artifact; weights_only=False to read its typed complete-ledger metadata; no unknown deserialization
